definitions.explanation: Indicates a time point and everything following it. The starting point is typically included.

examples.japanese: 10{時|じ}{以降|いこう}は{静|しず}かにしてください。
{来週|らいしゅう}{以降|いこう}は{忙|いそが}しくなる。
examples.english: From next week onward, I'll be busy.

examples.japanese: {2020年|にせんにじゅうねん}{以降|いこう}、{在宅|ざいたく}{勤務|きんむ}が{増|ふ}えた。

notes:
USAGE: Attached to time expressions to indicate 'from that point onward.' The reference point is usually included.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・Time + {以降|いこう} (from [time] onward)
・{以降|いこう} at the start of a sentence (from then on)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・{以来|いらい} (since - emphasizes continuation from the past)
・{以後|いご} (after - slightly more formal)
・{後|あと} (after - more casual)

NOTE: {以降|いこう} typically includes the reference point, so 10{時|じ}{以降|いこう} means '10 o'clock and after.'
